hphan-01-c1.text: Hereford Cathedral (2024). Mappa Mundi. Hereford Cathedral.
hphan-01-c1.quote: These 500 or so drawings include of around 420 cities and towns
hphan-01-c1.claim: The circle holds about 420 towns along with biblical scenes, animals, plants and peoples.

hphan-05-c1.text: Mark Cartwright (2015). Muisca Civilization. World History Encyclopedia.
hphan-05-c1.quote: Their territory encompassed what is now Bogotá and its environs and they have gained lasting fame as the origin of the El Dorado legend.
hphan-05-c1.claim: The story belongs to the Muisca, goldworking chiefdoms of the plateau around modern Bogotá.

hphan-06-c1.text: Thomas S. Garlinghouse (2017). On the Ocean: The Famous Voyage of Pytheas. World History Encyclopedia.
hphan-06-c1.quote: Pytheas apparently wrote On the Ocean at some point after he returned to Massalia.
hphan-06-c1.claim: and wrote a book, On the Ocean.
